# Assetto Corsa 1.16.4 / shared memory 1.7

Captured from a user-authorized local hotlap session on 21 August 2026 using
`capture_fixture`. The session used `ks_mazda_mx5_cup` at `zandvoort2023`.

`physics.bin` and `graphics.bin` contain only TRACE's validated page prefixes. The
static page was reconstructed from an allowlist containing shared-memory and game
versions, car/track source IDs, and temperatures. Player name, surname, nickname, and
all unsupported static fields are zeroed before the fixture is written.
